summary.en:
Kogoro is targeted by a killer who is after Kimura. Kogoro accidentally took his jacket at a bar and now the killer is trying to kill him.

Location: Next to construction site

Victim: Kogoro Mouri

victims.name: Kogoro Mouri and Ogawa, as well as Ran Mouri, and Conan Edogawa
victims.nameZh: 毛利小五郎、小川、毛利兰与江户川柯南
